Create an IAM user with administrator privileges for daily administrative tasks, instead of using the root user.
Use programmatic access instead of the root user and password.
cards.a: C. Enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) on the root user. ; D. Create an IAM user with administrator privileges for daily administrative tasks, instead of using the root user.
cards.explanation: Enabling MFA on root (C) protects against credential compromise, and creating an IAM admin user for daily tasks (D) avoids routine use of the all-powerful root account; sharing root credentials (A) and using programmatic root access (E) are both explicit anti-patterns.

cards.q: A company is running a critical workload on an Amazon RDS DB instance. The company needs the DB instance to be highly available with a recovery time of less than 5 minutes. Which solution will meet these requirements?
options: Create a read replica of the DB instance.
Create a template of the DB instance by using AWS CloudFormation.
Take frequent snapshots of the DB instance. Store the snapshots in Amazon S3.
Modify the DB instance to be a Multi-AZ deployment.
cards.a: D. Modify the DB instance to be a Multi-AZ deployment.
cards.explanation: Multi-AZ RDS deployments maintain a synchronous standby replica that automatically fails over in under 5 minutes if the primary fails; read replicas (A) are for read scaling and require manual promotion, which typically exceeds 5 minutes.

cards.q: A company plans to migrate its application to AWS and run the application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application will have continuous usage for 1 year. Which EC2 instance purchasing option will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
cards.explanation: Continuous 1-year usage is the ideal Reserved Instance scenario, offering up to 72% savings over On-Demand with a 1-year commitment; Spot Instances (B) can be interrupted and are unsuitable for continuous production workloads.

cards.q: Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework refers to the ability of a system to recover from infrastructure or service disruptions and dynamically acquire computing resources to meet demand?
cards.explanation: The Reliability pillar addresses a system's ability to recover from disruptions (fault tolerance) and dynamically scale to meet demand; Performance Efficiency (C) focuses on using compute resources efficiently relative to requirements, not on recovery and resilience.

cards.q: A company wants to identify Amazon S3 buckets that are shared with another AWS account. Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: IAM Access Analyzer uses automated reasoning to identify resources (including S3 buckets) that are shared with external AWS accounts or principals; the IAM credential report (B) lists user credentials status but does not analyze resource sharing policies.

cards.q: Which AWS service gives users the ability to build interactive business intelligence dashboards that include machine learning insights?
cards.explanation: Amazon QuickSight is a fully managed BI service for building interactive dashboards with built-in ML insights (forecasting, anomaly detection, narratives); Amazon Athena (A) runs SQL queries against S3 data but does not provide a dashboard or visualization layer.

cards.q: Which of the following is an AWS value proposition that describes a user's ability to scale infrastructure based on demand?
cards.explanation: Resource elasticity describes the cloud's ability to dynamically scale infrastructure up and down based on demand; decoupled architecture (C) is a design pattern, not a cloud value proposition about scaling.

cards.q: Which action is a security best practice for access to sensitive data that is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket?
options: Enable S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) on the S3 bucket.
Use IAM roles for applications that require access to the S3 bucket.
Configure AWS WAF to prevent unauthorized access to the S3 bucket.
Configure Amazon GuardDuty to prevent unauthorized access to the S3 bucket.
cards.a: B. Use IAM roles for applications that require access to the S3 bucket.
cards.explanation: Using IAM roles provides temporary, automatically rotated credentials for applications accessing S3, following the principle of least privilege; AWS WAF (C) protects web applications from HTTP exploits but cannot control access to S3 bucket objects.

cards.q: A company wants to know more about the benefits offered by cloud computing. The company wants to understand the operational advantage of agility. How does AWS provide agility for users?
options: The ability the ensure high availability by deploying workloads to multiple regions
A pay-as-you-go model for many services and resources
The ability to transfer infrastructure management to the AWS Cloud
The ability to provision and deprovision resources quickly with minimal effort
cards.a: D. The ability to provision and deprovision resources quickly with minimal effort
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed A ("ensure high availability by deploying to multiple regions"), but AWS documentation defines cloud agility as the ability to provision and deprovision resources quickly (D).; the standard agility definition maps to option D.

cards.q: A company needs a central user portal so that users can log in to third-party business applications that support Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2.0. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
options: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
cards.a: C. AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
cards.explanation: AWS IAM Identity Center (formerly AWS Single Sign-On) provides a central user portal for SSO access to multiple SAML 2.0-compatible business applications; Amazon Cognito (B) adds authentication to customer-facing web/mobile apps, not internal enterprise SSO portals.

cards.q: Which AWS service should users use to learn about AWS service availability and operations?
cards.explanation: The AWS Health Dashboard (combining Personal and Service Health) provides real-time visibility into AWS service availability, operations, and any events affecting the customer's account; AWS Service Catalog (B) manages approved IT service portfolios, not service health status.

cards.q: Which AWS service or tool can be used to capture information about inbound and outbound traffic in an Amazon VPC?
cards.explanation: VPC Flow Logs capture metadata about IP traffic (source, destination, port, protocol, action) flowing through network interfaces in the VPC; Amazon Inspector (B) scans for software vulnerabilities but does not capture network traffic data.

cards.q: What is the customer ALWAYS responsible for managing, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
cards.explanation: Customer data is always and exclusively the customer's responsibility regardless of the service used; AWS never accesses or manages customer data without explicit authorization.

cards.q: Which AWS service can be used to retrieve compliance reports on demand?
cards.explanation: AWS Artifact is a self-service portal for downloading AWS compliance reports (SOC, ISO, PCI, HIPAA) on demand; AWS Security Hub (C) aggregates security findings but does not provide downloadable compliance audit reports.

cards.q: A company plans to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company is gathering information about its on-premises infrastructure and requires information such as the hostname, IP address, and MAC address. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: AWS Application Discovery Service collects detailed information about on-premises servers including hostname, IP address, MAC address, CPU, memory, and running processes; AWS DataSync (A) transfers data but does not perform infrastructure discovery.

cards.q: Which action will help increase security in the AWS Cloud?
options: Enable programmatic access for all IAM users.
Use IAM users instead of IAM roles to delegate permissions.
Rotate access keys on a reoccurring basis.
Use inline policies instead of customer managed policies.
cards.a: C. Rotate access keys on a reoccurring basis.
cards.explanation: Rotating access keys regularly limits the window of exposure if a key is compromised; enabling programmatic access for all users (A) expands the attack surface unnecessarily since not all users require CLI/API access.

cards.q: A company is planning to migrate its application to the AWS Cloud. Which AWS tool or set of resources should the company use to analyze and assess its readiness for migration?
cards.a: A. AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF)
cards.explanation: The AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) provides guidance for assessing organizational readiness for cloud migration across six perspectives (Business, People, Governance, Platform, Security, Operations); the Well-Architected Framework (C) evaluates existing workload architectures, not migration readiness.

cards.q: Which of the following describes some of the core functionality of Amazon S3?
options: Amazon S3 is a high-performance block storage service that is designed for use with Amazon EC2.
Amazon S3 is an object storage service that provides high-level performance, security, scalability, and data availability.
Amazon S3 is a fully managed, highly reliable, and scalable file storage system that is accessible over the industry-standard SMB protocol.
Amazon S3 is a scalable, fully managed elastic NFS for use with AWS Cloud services and on-premises resources.
cards.a: B. Amazon S3 is an object storage service that provides high-level performance, security, scalability, and data availability.
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed D (describing NFS), which actually describes Amazon EFS, not S3. The correct description of S3 is option B (object storage with high performance, security, scalability, and data availability).

cards.q: Which AWS benefit is demonstrated by on-demand technology services that enable companies to replace upfront fixed expenses with variable expenses?
cards.explanation: Pay-as-you-go pricing replaces large upfront fixed capital expenditures with variable costs that align with actual consumption; economies of scale (B) describe aggregate purchasing power reducing per-unit costs, not the shift from fixed to variable expenses.

cards.q: Which AWS services or features enable users to connect on-premises networks to a VPC? (Choose two.)
cards.a: A. AWS VPN ; C. AWS Direct Connect
cards.explanation: AWS VPN creates an encrypted tunnel over the internet connecting on-premises networks to VPCs; AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated private physical link; VPC peering (D) connects two VPCs within AWS, not on-premises networks to VPCs.

cards.q: Which actions are examples of a company's effort to rightsize its AWS resources to control cloud costs? (Choose two.)
options: Switch from Amazon RDS to Amazon DynamoDB to accommodate NoSQL datasets.
Base the selection of Amazon EC2 instance types on past utilization patterns.
Use Amazon S3 Lifecycle policies to move objects that users access infrequently to lower-cost storage tiers.
Use Multi-AZ deployments for Amazon RDS.
Replace existing Amazon EC2 instances with AWS Elastic Beanstalk.
cards.a: B. Base the selection of Amazon EC2 instance types on past utilization patterns. ; C. Use Amazon S3 Lifecycle policies to move objects that users access infrequently to lower-cost storage tiers.
cards.explanation: Selecting EC2 instance types based on past utilization (B) eliminates overprovisioned instances; using S3 Lifecycle policies to move infrequently accessed data to cheaper tiers (C) reduces storage costs by matching storage class to access patterns; Multi-AZ (D) adds cost for redundancy and is not a rightsizing activity.

cards.q: Which AWS service or feature can a company use to apply security rules to specific Amazon EC2 instances?
cards.explanation: Security groups are stateful, instance-level firewalls that can be applied to specific EC2 instances to control inbound/outbound traffic; Network ACLs (A) operate at the subnet level and apply to all instances in the subnet, not to specific instances.

cards.q: Which design principles support the reliability pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework? (Choose two.)
options: Deploy resources globally to improve response time.
cards.a: C. Automatically scale to meet demand. ; E. Automatically recover from failure.
cards.explanation: Automatically scaling to meet demand (C) prevents overload-induced failures, and automatically recovering from failure (E) reduces mean time to recovery; performing operations as code (A) is an Operational Excellence pillar principle, not Reliability.

cards.q: A company that uses AWS needs to transfer 2 TB of data. Which type of transfer of that data would result in no cost for the company?
options: Inbound data transfer from the internet
Outbound data transfer to the internet
cards.a: A. Inbound data transfer from the internet
cards.explanation: Inbound data transfer from the internet into AWS is always free; outbound data transfer to the internet (B), between Regions (C), and between AZs (D) all incur charges.

cards.q: A company is building an application that requires the ability to send, store, and receive messages between application components. The company has another requirement to process messages in first-in, first-out (FIFO) order. Which AWS service should the company use?
cards.a: D. Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS)
cards.explanation: Amazon SQS supports FIFO queues that guarantee exactly-once processing and strict message ordering; Amazon SNS (B) is a pub/sub notification service that does not guarantee ordered delivery or FIFO semantics.

cards.q: Which AWS service or feature is a browser-based, pre-authenticated service that can be launched directly from the AWS Management Console?
cards.explanation: AWS CloudShell is a browser-based shell pre-authenticated with the user's console credentials and launched directly from the AWS Management Console; AWS Cloud9 (C) is a cloud IDE for development that requires setup and is not a pre-authenticated shell experience.

cards.q: A company wants to migrate its database to a managed AWS service that is compatible with PostgreSQL. Which AWS services will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
cards.a: B. Amazon RDS ; E. Amazon Aurora
cards.explanation: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition are both fully managed services that support the PostgreSQL engine natively; Amazon DynamoDB (D) is a NoSQL database incompatible with PostgreSQL.

cards.q: A company has a fleet of cargo ships. The cargo ships have sensors that collect data at sea, where there is intermittent or no internet connectivity. The company needs to collect, format, and process the data at sea and move the data to AWS later. Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: AWS Snowball Edge has local compute and storage capabilities, enabling data collection and processing in disconnected environments (like at sea) with later transfer to AWS; AWS IoT Core (A) requires internet connectivity for real-time communication.

cards.q: A company hosts an application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances. The application uses Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send messages. Which AWS service or feature will give the application permission to access required AWS services?
cards.explanation: IAM roles attached to EC2 instances provide temporary credentials that grant permissions to call other AWS services like SNS; AWS Certificate Manager (A) manages SSL/TLS certificates and does not grant service-level API permissions.

cards.q: A user has limited knowledge of AWS services, but wants to quickly deploy a scalable Node.js application in the AWS Cloud. Which service should be used to deploy the application?
cards.explanation: AWS Elastic Beanstalk allows developers to simply upload code and automatically handles provisioning, load balancing, and scaling, requiring no deep AWS knowledge; CloudFormation (A) requires writing infrastructure templates and more AWS expertise.

cards.q: A company needs a content delivery network that provides secure delivery of data, videos, applications, and APIs to users globally with low latency and high transfer speeds. Which AWS service meets these requirements?
cards.explanation: Amazon CloudFront is AWS's global CDN that delivers data, videos, applications, and APIs with low latency through 400+ edge locations with built-in DDoS protection and HTTPS; Elastic Load Balancing (B) distributes traffic within a region but is not a global CDN.

cards.q: A company needs to use third-party software for its workload on AWS. Which AWS service or feature can the company use to purchase the software?
cards.explanation: AWS Marketplace is the digital catalog where customers can find, purchase, and deploy third-party software solutions that run on AWS; AWS License Manager (C) tracks and manages existing license usage but is not a purchasing platform.

cards.q: A company needs fully managed, highly reliable, and scalable file storage that is accessible over the Server Message Block (SMB) protocol. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
options: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
cards.a: C. Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
cards.explanation: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server provides a fully managed, native Windows file system accessible over SMB with Active Directory integration; Amazon EFS (B) supports NFS protocol for Linux workloads, not SMB.

cards.q: A company needs to centrally configure and manage Amazon VPC security groups across multiple AWS accounts within an organization in AWS Organizations. Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: AWS Firewall Manager centrally configures and manages security group rules, WAF rules, and Shield protections across all accounts in an AWS Organization; Amazon GuardDuty (B) detects threats but cannot manage or enforce security group configurations.

cards.q: Which task is a responsibility of AWS, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: Configure identity and access management for applications.
Manage encryption options for data that is stored on AWS.
Configure security groups for Amazon EC2 instances.
Maintain the physical hardware of the infrastructure.
cards.a: D. Maintain the physical hardware of the infrastructure.
cards.explanation: Maintaining physical hardware (servers, networking, storage) in data centers is entirely AWS's responsibility; configuring security groups (C) and managing encryption options (B) are customer responsibilities.

cards.q: A company has an Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet. The company wants to initiate a connection to the internet to pull operating system updates while preventing traffic from the internet from accessing the EC2 instance. Which AWS managed service allows this?
cards.explanation: A NAT gateway allows instances in private subnets to initiate outbound connections to the internet (for updates) while preventing unsolicited inbound connections from reaching those instances; VPC endpoints (A) connect to AWS services privately without traversing the internet.

cards.q: Which actions are the responsibility of AWS, according to the AWS shared responsibility model? (Choose two.)
options: Patching the operating system on Amazon EC2 instances
Enforcing a strict password policy for IAM users
Patching the operating system on Amazon RDS instances
Configuring security groups and network ACLs
cards.a: A. Securing the virtualization layer ; D. Patching the operating system on Amazon RDS instances
cards.explanation: AWS secures the virtualization/hypervisor layer (A) and patches the OS on fully managed services like RDS (D); patching EC2 guest OS (B) and configuring security groups/NACLs (E) are customer responsibilities.

cards.q: A company is storing data that will not be frequently accessed in the AWS Cloud. If the company needs to access the data, the data needs to be retrieved within 12 hours. The company wants a solution that is cost-effective for storage costs for each gigabyte. Which Amazon S3 storage class will meet these requirements?
options: S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)
cards.explanation: S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval offers the lowest per-GB storage cost among the listed options, with retrieval times from minutes to 12 hours, meeting the 12-hour requirement; S3 Standard-IA (D) costs more per GB and is better suited for data that needs immediate access.

cards.q: Which AWS service or resource can be used to identify services that have been used by a user within a specified date range?
options: AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer
cards.a: D. AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer
cards.explanation: IAM Access Analyzer can generate findings showing which services a user accessed within a specified time period via its policy generation and access analysis features; S3 ACLs (A) control bucket/object permissions but do not track user activity history.

cards.q: A company needs to engage third-party consultants to help maintain and support its AWS environment and the company's business needs. Which AWS service or resource will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: The AWS Partner Network (APN) connects companies with qualified third-party consulting partners who can help maintain, support, and optimize AWS environments; AWS Support (A) provides AWS technical support but does not connect companies with external consultants.

cards.q: A company wants to create Amazon QuickSight dashboards every week by using its billing data. Which AWS feature or tool can the company use to meet these requirements?
cards.a: C. AWS Cost and Usage Report
cards.explanation: The AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR) provides the most granular billing data in CSV format that can be loaded into QuickSight for custom dashboard creation; AWS Budgets (A) tracks spending against thresholds but does not provide raw data for BI dashboards.

cards.q: A company needs to organize its resources and track AWS costs on a detailed level. The company needs to categorize costs by business department, environment, and application. Which solution will meet these requirements?
options: Access the AWS Cost Management console to organize resources, set an AWS budget, and receive notifications of unintentional usage.
Use tags to organize the resources. Activate cost allocation tags to track AWS costs on a detailed level.
Create Amazon CloudWatch dashboards to visually organize and track costs individually.
Access the AWS Billing and Cost Management dashboard to organize and track resource consumption on a detailed level.
cards.a: B. Use tags to organize the resources. Activate cost allocation tags to track AWS costs on a detailed level.
cards.explanation: Resource tags allow categorizing AWS resources by business department, environment, application, or any custom taxonomy; activating cost allocation tags surfaces these categories in billing reports for detailed cost tracking.

cards.q: A company needs to plan, schedule, and run hundreds of thousands of computing jobs on AWS. Which AWS service can the company use to meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: AWS Batch efficiently plans, schedules, and executes hundreds of thousands of batch computing jobs across managed or unmanaged compute environments; AWS Step Functions (A) orchestrates workflow states but is not purpose-built for massive batch job scheduling.

cards.q: Which AWS services or features provide high availability and low latency by enabling failover across different AWS Regions? (Choose two.)
cards.a: A. Amazon Route 53 ; D. AWS Global Accelerator
cards.explanation: Amazon Route 53 supports DNS-based health checks and failover routing across Regions; AWS Global Accelerator routes traffic over the AWS backbone with automatic Regional failover; Network Load Balancer (B) and Application Load Balancer (E) operate within a single Region only.

cards.q: Which of the following is a way to use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups to scale capacity in the AWS Cloud?
options: Scale the number of EC2 instances in or out automatically, based on demand.
Scale the size of EC2 instances up or down automatically, based on demand.
Transfer unused CPU resources between EC2 instances.
cards.a: A. Scale the number of EC2 instances in or out automatically, based on demand.
cards.explanation: EC2 Auto Scaling adjusts the number (horizontal scale) of instances in a group by launching or terminating instances based on demand; it does not change the size/type of existing instances (C) or transfer resources between instances (D).

cards.q: Which abilities are benefits of the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)
options: Trade variable expenses for capital expenses.
Plan capacity in advance of deployments.
Take advantage of economies of scale.
cards.a: B. Deploy globally in minutes. ; D. Take advantage of economies of scale.
cards.explanation: "Deploy globally in minutes" (B) reflects the cloud's ability to launch resources in any Region instantly; "economies of scale" (D) means AWS passes aggregate volume discounts to customers; planning capacity in advance (C) is what the cloud eliminates, not a benefit.

cards.q: Which AWS security service protects applications from distributed denial of service attacks with always-on detection and automatic inline mitigations?
cards.explanation: AWS Shield (Standard and Advanced) provides always-on DDoS detection and automatic inline mitigation; AWS WAF (B) protects against application-layer attacks (SQL injection, XSS) but is not specifically a DDoS mitigation service.

cards.q: Which AWS service allows users to model and provision AWS resources using common programming languages?
cards.a: C. AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK)
cards.explanation: AWS CDK allows developers to define infrastructure using TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, and Go, then synthesizes to CloudFormation; CloudFormation (A) uses JSON/YAML templates, not general-purpose programming languages.

cards.q: Which of the following acts as an instance-level firewall to control inbound and outbound access?
cards.explanation: Security groups act as a stateful instance-level firewall controlling inbound and outbound traffic per ENI; Network ACLs (A) are stateless and operate at the subnet level, not the instance level.

cards.q: A company must be able to develop, test, and launch an application in the AWS Cloud quickly. Which advantage of cloud computing will meet these requirements?
options: Trade fixed expense for variable expense
cards.explanation: "Increase speed and agility" directly describes the ability to rapidly develop, test, and launch applications by provisioning environments in minutes; "stop guessing capacity" (A) relates to elasticity, not development speed.

cards.q: A company has teams that have different job roles and responsibilities. The company's employees often change teams. The company needs to manage permissions for the employees so that the permissions are appropriate for the job responsibilities. Which IAM resource should the company use to meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
cards.explanation: IAM user groups let administrators assign permissions to a group; when employees change teams, simply moving them between groups updates their permissions with minimal overhead; managing individual policies per user (D) creates high operational burden at scale.

cards.q: Which encryption types can be used to protect objects at rest in Amazon S3? (Choose two.)
options: Server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3)
Server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed keys (SSE-KMS)
cards.a: A. Server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3) ; B. Server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed keys (SSE-KMS)
cards.explanation: SSE-S3 (A) encrypts with Amazon-managed keys and SSE-KMS (B) encrypts with AWS KMS-managed keys - both are server-side encryption methods protecting objects at rest; TLS (C) and SSL (D) are transport-layer protocols that protect data in transit, not at rest.

cards.q: A company wants to integrate its online shopping website with social media login credentials. Which AWS service can the company use to make this integration?
options: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
cards.explanation: Amazon Cognito provides user sign-up/sign-in with built-in social identity federation (Google, Facebook, Apple, Amazon) for customer-facing web and mobile applications; IAM Identity Center (D) is for enterprise workforce SSO, not consumer-facing social login.

cards.q: Which AWS service is used to track, record, and audit configuration changes made to AWS resources?
cards.explanation: AWS Config continuously tracks and records configuration changes to AWS resources and evaluates compliance against desired configurations; AWS Shield (A) is a DDoS protection service with no configuration auditing capability.

cards.q: A customer runs an On-Demand Amazon Linux EC2 instance for 3 hours, 5 minutes, and 6 seconds. For how much time will the customer be billed?
cards.explanation: Amazon EC2 Linux instances are billed per second with a one-minute minimum; the customer is billed for exactly 3 hours, 5 minutes, and 6 seconds of usage.

cards.q: A company website is experiencing DDoS attacks. Which AWS service can help protect the company website against these attacks?
cards.explanation: AWS Shield (Standard included free, Advanced for enhanced protection) specifically protects against DDoS attacks with always-on detection and automatic mitigation; Amazon GuardDuty (D) detects threats from logs but does not actively mitigate DDoS traffic.

cards.q: A company wants a customized assessment of its current on-premises environment. The company wants to understand its projected running costs in the AWS Cloud. Which AWS service or tool will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: Migration Evaluator (formerly TSO Logic) provides a customized assessment of on-premises environments and projects the cost of running those workloads in the AWS Cloud; AWS Trusted Advisor (A) reviews existing AWS environments for best practices, not on-premises migration cost projections.

cards.q: A company is hosting an application in the AWS Cloud. The company wants to verify that underlying AWS services and general AWS infrastructure are operating normally. Which combination of AWS services can the company use to gather the required information? (Choose two.)
cards.a: A. AWS Personal Health Dashboard ; D. AWS Service Health Dashboard
cards.explanation: The AWS Personal Health Dashboard (A) shows events affecting the customer's specific resources; the AWS Service Health Dashboard (D) shows the general operational status of all AWS services across Regions; together they provide full visibility into AWS service and infrastructure health.

cards.q: A company needs to migrate a PostgreSQL database from on-premises to Amazon RDS. Which AWS service or tool should the company use to meet this requirement?
cards.a: C. AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS)
cards.explanation: AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) supports homogeneous migrations (PostgreSQL to RDS PostgreSQL) with continuous data replication and minimal downtime; AWS Migration Hub (B) tracks migration progress but does not perform the actual database migration.

cards.q: Which cloud concept is demonstrated by using AWS Compute Optimizer?
cards.explanation: AWS Compute Optimizer analyzes utilization metrics and recommends optimal instance types/sizes, directly implementing the rightsizing cloud concept; elasticity (C) is about automatic scaling, not instance type optimization.

cards.q: Who enables encryption of data at rest for Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)?
cards.explanation: The customer enables EBS encryption by selecting the encryption option when creating volumes or by setting account-level default encryption; AWS KMS (C) provides the encryption keys but does not decide whether encryption is enabled - the customer makes that choice.

cards.q: What can a user accomplish using AWS CloudTrail?
options: Generate an IAM user credentials report.
Record API calls made to AWS services.
Assess the compliance of AWS resource configurations with policies and guidelines.
Ensure that Amazon EC2 instances are patched with the latest security updates.
cards.a: B. Record API calls made to AWS services.
cards.explanation: AWS CloudTrail records all API calls made to AWS services, capturing the identity of the caller, timestamp, source IP, and parameters; generating a credential report (A) is done through IAM, not CloudTrail.

cards.q: A company is planning to host its workloads on AWS. Which AWS service requires the company to update and patch the guest operating system?
cards.explanation: Amazon EC2 is an IaaS service where the customer manages and patches the guest operating system; DynamoDB (A), S3 (B), and Aurora (D) are managed services where AWS handles OS maintenance.

cards.q: A company is migrating its workloads to the AWS Cloud. The company must retain full control of patch management for the guest operating systems that host its applications. Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (AWS Lambda), but Lambda is serverless and the customer has no access to or control over the underlying OS. Amazon EC2 (B) is the correct answer for retaining full control of OS patch management.

cards.q: At what support level do users receive access to a support concierge?
cards.explanation: Enterprise Support includes access to a Support Concierge who assists with billing, account, and non-technical inquiries; Business Support (C) provides 24/7 technical support but does not include a dedicated concierge.

cards.q: Which AWS service can a company use to visually design and build serverless applications?
cards.explanation: AWS Application Composer provides a visual drag-and-drop interface for designing and building serverless applications, generating IaC templates automatically; AWS Lambda (A) is the compute runtime itself, not a visual design tool.

cards.q: A company wants to migrate to AWS and use the same security software it uses on premises. The security software vendor offers its security software as a service on AWS. Where can the company purchase the security solution?
cards.explanation: AWS Marketplace is the online store where customers can find, buy, and immediately deploy third-party security software and other solutions that run on AWS; AWS Partner Solutions Finder (A) helps find consulting partners, not purchase software directly.

cards.q: A company has deployed an Amazon EC2 instance. Which option is an AWS responsibility under the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: Installing updates and security patches of guest operating system
Configuration of security groups on each instance
cards.explanation: Configuration of infrastructure devices (network equipment, physical servers, hypervisors) is entirely AWS's responsibility; installing guest OS updates (B) and configuring security groups (D) are customer responsibilities.

cards.q: A company wants to migrate its PostgreSQL database to AWS. The company does not use the database frequently. Which AWS service or resource will meet these requirements with the LEAST management overhead?
cards.explanation: Amazon Aurora Serverless automatically scales capacity up and down (including to zero) based on demand, eliminating management overhead for infrequently used databases; standard RDS (B) and Aurora (C) require managing provisioned capacity even during idle periods.

cards.q: A company is using Amazon DynamoDB for its application database. Which tasks are the responsibility of AWS, according to the AWS shared responsibility model? (Choose two.)
options: Provide public endpoints to store and retrieve data.
Manage the infrastructure layer and the operating system.
cards.a: D. Provide public endpoints to store and retrieve data. ; E. Manage the infrastructure layer and the operating system.
cards.explanation: AWS provides public endpoints (D) for DynamoDB access and manages the underlying infrastructure and operating system (E); classifying data (A) and configuring access permissions (B) are customer responsibilities.

cards.q: A company wants to create a globally accessible ecommerce platform for its customers. The company wants to use a highly available and scalable DNS web service to connect users to the platform. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: Amazon Route 53 is a highly available, scalable DNS web service that routes end users to internet applications globally; Amazon VPC (B) is a virtual network within a region, not a DNS routing service.

cards.q: Which maintenance task is the customer's responsibility, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: Amazon EC2 updates and security patches
cards.a: D. Amazon EC2 updates and security patches
cards.explanation: Patching and updating the guest operating system on Amazon EC2 instances is the customer's responsibility; physical connectivity (A), network switch maintenance (B), and hardware firmware (C) are all AWS's responsibilities.

cards.q: A company that has AWS Enterprise Support is launching a new version of a popular product in 2 months. The company expects a large increase in traffic to its website. The website is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. Which action should the company take to assess its readiness to scale for this launch?
options: Replace the EC2 instances with AWS Lambda functions.
Use AWS Infrastructure Event Management (IEM) support.
Submit a request on AWS Marketplace to monitor the event.
Review the coverage reports in the AWS Cost Management console.
cards.a: B. Use AWS Infrastructure Event Management (IEM) support.
cards.explanation: AWS Infrastructure Event Management (IEM) is an Enterprise Support feature that provides architecture and scaling guidance plus operational support for planned events like product launches; replacing EC2 with Lambda (A) is a re-architecture, not a readiness assessment.

cards.q: A company wants to launch multiple workloads on AWS. Each workload is related to a different business unit. The company wants to separate and track costs for each business unit. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Use AWS Organizations and create one account for each business unit.
Use a spreadsheet to control the owners and cost of each resource.
Use an Amazon DynamoDB table to record costs for each business unit.
Use the AWS Billing console to assign owners to resources and track costs.
cards.a: A. Use AWS Organizations and create one account for each business unit.
cards.explanation: Using AWS Organizations with separate accounts per business unit automatically provides isolated cost tracking per account with consolidated billing, requiring the least operational overhead; manual spreadsheets (B) and DynamoDB tables (C) require significant ongoing effort.

cards.q: A company wants a time-series database service that makes it easier to store and analyze trillions of events each day. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: Amazon Timestream is a purpose-built serverless time-series database optimized for storing and analyzing trillions of time-stamped events per day; Amazon Neptune (A) is a graph database for relationship-based queries, not time-series analytics.

cards.q: Which option is a shared control between AWS and the customer, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
cards.explanation: Configuration management is a shared control because AWS configures infrastructure components while the customer configures their guest OS, applications, and databases; physical and environmental controls (B) are solely AWS's responsibility.

cards.q: A company wants to store data in Amazon S3. The company rarely access the data, and the data can be regenerated if necessary. The company wants to store the data in the most cost-effective storage class. Which S3 storage class will meet this requirement?
options: S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)
cards.a: D. S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)
cards.explanation: S3 One Zone-IA is the cheapest storage class for infrequently accessed, recreatable data because it stores data in a single AZ (lower redundancy = lower cost); S3 Standard-IA (C) stores data across multiple AZs and costs more per GB.

cards.q: A company has migrated its workloads to AWS. The company wants to adopt AWS at scale and operate more efficiently and securely. Which AWS service or framework should the company use for operational support?
cards.explanation: AWS Managed Services (AMS) provides ongoing operational management of AWS infrastructure (patching, monitoring, incident management, security), reducing management overhead; the Well-Architected Framework (D) provides guidance but not operational management services.

cards.q: Which Amazon EC2 pricing model provides the MOST cost savings for an always-up, right-sized database server running for a project that will last 1 year?
cards.explanation: Standard Reserved Instances offer the highest discount (up to 72%) for a fixed instance type over 1 year; Convertible Reserved Instances (B) provide lower discounts (~54%) in exchange for flexibility to change instance families.

cards.q: A company is using the AWS Free Tier for several AWS services for an application. What will happen if the Free Tier usage period expires or if the application use exceeds the Free Tier usage limits?
options: The company will be charged the standard pay-as-you-go service rates for the usage that exceeds the Free Tier usage.
AWS Support will contact the company to set up standard service charges.
The company will be charged for the services it consumed during the Free Tier period, plus additional charges for service consumption after the Free Tier period.
The company's AWS account will be frozen and can be restarted after a payment plan is established.
cards.a: A. The company will be charged the standard pay-as-you-go service rates for the usage that exceeds the Free Tier usage.
cards.explanation: When the Free Tier expires or usage exceeds free limits, the standard pay-as-you-go rates automatically apply to additional usage; there is no retroactive charge for usage during the Free Tier period (C is incorrect) and the account is not frozen (D).

cards.q: A company wants to monitor its workload performance. The company wants to ensure that the cloud services are delivered at a level that meets its business needs. Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: The Operations perspective of the AWS CAF focuses on ensuring cloud services are delivered at levels meeting business needs, including monitoring workload performance, event/incident management, and service-level management.

cards.q: A company wants to migrate its applications to the AWS Cloud. The company plans to identify and prioritize any business transformation opportunities and evaluate its AWS Cloud readiness. Which AWS service or tool should the company use to meet these requirements?
cards.a: A. AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF)
cards.explanation: The AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) guides organizations in identifying transformation opportunities, assessing cloud readiness, and prioritizing actions across six perspectives; AWS Migration Hub (D) tracks migration progress but does not assess readiness or prioritize business transformation.

cards.q: A company need an AWS service that provides a clear baseline of what the company runs in its on-premises data centers. The company needs the projected cost to run its on-premises workloads in the AWS Cloud. What AWS service or tool will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: Migration Evaluator collects on-premises inventory data and projects the total cost of ownership for running those workloads in AWS; AWS Cost Explorer (B) analyzes costs for resources already running in AWS, not on-premises projected costs.

cards.q: A company wants to set up its workloads to perform their intended functions and recover quickly from failure. Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework aligns with these goals?
cards.explanation: The Reliability pillar focuses on ensuring workloads perform their intended functions correctly and recover quickly from failures; Performance Efficiency (A) focuses on using resources efficiently, not on recovery from failure.

cards.q: Which of the following is a managed AWS service that is used specifically for extract, transform, and load (ETL) data?
cards.explanation: AWS Glue is a fully managed serverless ETL service for discovering, preparing, and transforming data; Amazon Athena (A) is a query service for analyzing data in S3 with SQL, not an ETL tool.

cards.q: A company wants to migrate petabytes of data from its on-premises data center to AWS. The company does not want to use an internet connection to perform the migration. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: AWS Snowmobile is a 100 PB-capacity truck for physically transporting petabytes of data to AWS without using the internet; AWS DataSync (A) transfers data over a network connection, which the company wants to avoid.

cards.q: How does the AWS Enterprise Support Concierge team help users?
options: Answering questions regarding technical support cases
cards.a: C. Answering billing and account inquiries
cards.explanation: The Enterprise Support Concierge team specifically assists with billing and account inquiries (billing disputes, payment methods, account setup); architecture guidance (B) comes from the TAM or Solutions Architects, not the Concierge.

cards.q: Which AWS service or resource can provide discounts on some AWS service costs in exchange for a spending commitment?
cards.explanation: Savings Plans provide discounted rates (up to 72% off On-Demand) in exchange for a commitment to a consistent amount of compute usage ($/hour) for 1 or 3 years; the Pricing Calculator (B) estimates costs but does not offer discounts.

cards.q: Which of the following are pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework? (Choose two.)
cards.a: B. Performance efficiency ; C. Cost optimization
cards.explanation: The six Well-Architected Framework pillars are Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, and Sustainability; high availability (A) and going global in minutes (D) are cloud benefits, not named pillars.

cards.q: A company wants to use Amazon EC2 instances to provide a static website to users all over the world. The company needs to minimize latency for the users. Which solution meets these requirements?
options: Use EC2 instances in multiple edge locations.
Use EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone but in different AWS Regions.
Use Amazon CloudFront with the EC2 instances configured as the source.
Use EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone but in different AWS accounts.
cards.a: C. Use Amazon CloudFront with the EC2 instances configured as the source.
cards.explanation: Using Amazon CloudFront in front of EC2 caches content at edge locations worldwide, minimizing latency for global users; EC2 instances do not run in edge locations (A) and placing instances in the same AZ across Regions (B) is nonsensical architecture.

cards.q: A team of researchers is going to collect data at remote locations around the world. Many locations do not have internet connectivity. The team needs to capture the data in the field, and transfer it to the AWS Cloud later. Which AWS service will support these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (AWS Transfer Family), but Transfer Family provides managed SFTP/FTPS/FTP endpoints requiring network connectivity. AWS Snow Family (C) is designed for data collection in disconnected field environments.

cards.q: Which of the following are benefits that a company receives when it moves an on-premises production workload to AWS? (Choose two.)
options: AWS trains the company's staff on the use of all the AWS services.
AWS manages all security in the cloud.
AWS offers free support from technical account managers (TAMs).
cards.a: D. AWS offers high availability. ; E. AWS provides economies of scale.
cards.explanation: AWS offers high availability through Multi-AZ and multi-Region architectures (D); economies of scale from massive aggregated demand lower per-unit pricing for all customers (E); AWS does not manage all security (B) - customers retain responsibility for "security in the cloud."

cards.q: Which of the following are benefits of AWS Trusted Advisor? (Choose two.)
options: Access to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS)
Hourly refresh of the service limit checks
AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) approval management
cards.a: B. Cost optimization recommendations ; D. Security checks
cards.explanation: Trusted Advisor provides cost optimization recommendations by identifying underutilized resources (B) and security checks by flagging misconfigurations like open ports or missing MFA (D); it does not provide SQS access (A) or IAM approval management (E).

cards.q: A company wants to save costs by archiving data that is no longer frequently accessed by end users. Which Amazon S3 feature will meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: S3 Lifecycle policies automatically transition objects to cheaper storage classes (or expire them) based on age or access patterns, enabling cost-effective archival; S3 Versioning (A) keeps multiple versions for recovery but does not move data to cheaper tiers.

cards.q: Which cloud computing advantage is a company applying when it uses AWS Regions to increase application availability to users in different countries?
cards.explanation: Global reach is the cloud advantage of deploying applications across multiple geographic Regions to serve users worldwide with lower latency and higher availability; economies of scale (C) describe cost benefits from aggregated demand, not geographic distribution.

cards.q: A company wants an AWS service to collect and process 10 TB of data locally and transfer the data to AWS. The company has intermittent connectivity. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: AWS Snowball Edge has local compute and storage for collecting and processing data in environments with intermittent connectivity, then physically ships to AWS; AWS DataSync (B) requires consistent network connectivity for data transfer.

cards.q: Which of the following is an AWS Well-Architected Framework design principle for operational excellence in the AWS Cloud?
options: Implement a strong foundation of identity and access management
Stop spending money on hardware infrastructure for data center operations.
cards.a: B. Make frequent, small, reversible changes.
cards.explanation: "Make frequent, small, reversible changes" is an explicit Operational Excellence design principle, enabling rapid iteration with reduced blast radius; "go global in minutes" (A) is a general cloud benefit, not a specific Well-Architected design principle for operational excellence.

cards.q: What is a benefit of using AWS serverless computing?
options: Application deployment and management are not required.
Application security will be fully managed by AWS.
Monitoring and logging are not needed.
Management of infrastructure is offloaded to AWS.
cards.a: A. Application deployment and management are not required.
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed A ("application deployment and management are not required"), but this is misleading. The more standard answer for serverless benefits is D ("management of infrastructure is offloaded to AWS"), since customers still deploy and manage their application code.

cards.q: A developer wants AWS users to access AWS services by using temporary security credentials. Which AWS service or feature should the developer use to provide these credentials?
options: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
cards.a: C. AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS)
cards.explanation: AWS Security Token Service (STS) issues temporary, limited-privilege security credentials for IAM roles or federated users; IAM policies (A) define permissions but do not themselves issue credentials.

cards.q: Which of the following is the customer's responsibility under the AWS shared responsibility model? (Choose two.)
options: Maintain the configuration of infrastructure devices.
Maintain patching and updates within the hardware infrastructure.
Maintain the configuration of guest operating systems and applications.
cards.a: C. Maintain the configuration of guest operating systems and applications. ; D. Manage decisions involving encryption options.
cards.explanation: Configuring guest operating systems and applications (C) and managing encryption options for data (D) are customer responsibilities; maintaining infrastructure hardware (E) and patching hardware (B) are AWS's responsibilities.

cards.q: A company wants to verify if multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled for all users within its AWS accounts. Which AWS service or resource will meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: The IAM credential report is a downloadable CSV listing all IAM users and whether MFA is enabled for each; AWS Cost and Usage Report (A) tracks billing data, not security configurations like MFA status.

cards.q: A company uses AWS security services and tools. The company needs a service to help manage the security alerts and must organize the alerts into a single dashboard. Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: AWS Security Hub aggregates, organizes, and prioritizes security findings from multiple AWS services (GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie) into a single unified dashboard; GuardDuty (A) generates its own findings but does not aggregate alerts from other services.

cards.q: A company wants to run its workloads in the AWS Cloud effectively, reduce management overhead, and improve processes. Which AWS Well-Architected Framework pillar represents these requirements?
cards.explanation: Operational Excellence focuses on running workloads effectively, improving supporting processes, and reducing management overhead through automation and continuous improvement; Cost Optimization (D) focuses on avoiding unnecessary costs, not on operational efficiency.

cards.q: An external auditor has requested that a company provide a list of all its IAM users, including the status of users' credentials and access keys. What is the SIMPLEST way to provide this information?
options: Create an IAM user account for the auditor, granting the auditor administrator permissions.
Take a screenshot of each user's page in the AWS Management Console, then provide the screenshots to the auditor.
Download the IAM credential report, then provide the report to the auditor.
Download the AWS Trusted Advisor report, then provide the report to the auditor.
cards.a: C. Download the IAM credential report, then provide the report to the auditor.
cards.explanation: The IAM credential report is a single downloadable CSV file containing all users and their credential status (passwords, access keys, MFA); creating an admin account for the auditor (A) violates the principle of least privilege.

cards.q: Which task can a company perform by using security groups in the AWS Cloud?
options: Allow access to an Amazon EC2 instance through only a specific port.
Deny access to malicious IP addresses at a subnet level.
Protect data that is cached by Amazon CloudFront.
Apply a stateless firewall to an Amazon EC2 instance.
cards.a: A. Allow access to an Amazon EC2 instance through only a specific port.
cards.explanation: Security groups allow defining rules that permit traffic on specific ports (e.g., allow TCP port 443 only), controlling access at the instance level; denying traffic at the subnet level (B) is done by Network ACLs, not security groups.

cards.q: A company plans to run a compute-intensive workload that uses graphics processing units (GPUs). Which Amazon EC2 instance type should the company use?
cards.explanation: Accelerated computing instances (P, G, Inf families) include GPUs and other hardware accelerators for graphics-intensive and ML workloads; compute optimized (B) provides high CPU performance but does not include GPUs.

cards.q: Which of the following are features of network ACLs as they are used in the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)
options: They evaluate all rules before allowing traffic.
They process rules in order, starting with the lowest numbered rule, when deciding whether to allow traffic.
They operate at the instance level.
cards.a: A. They are stateless. ; D. They process rules in order, starting with the lowest numbered rule, when deciding whether to allow traffic.
cards.explanation: Network ACLs are stateless (A), meaning return traffic must be explicitly allowed, and they process rules in numerical order (D), applying the first matching rule; security groups (not NACLs) are stateful (B) and evaluate all rules before deciding (C).

cards.q: Which capabilities are in the platform perspective of the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF)? (Choose two.)
cards.a: B. Data engineering ; C. Continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD)
cards.explanation: The Platform perspective of the AWS CAF includes data engineering (B) for building data platforms and CI/CD (C) for software delivery pipelines; infrastructure protection (D) belongs to the Security perspective and performance management (A) belongs to Operations.

cards.q: According to the AWS shared responsibility model, the customer is responsible for applying the latest security updates and patches for which of the following?
cards.explanation: For EC2 (IaaS), the customer is responsible for patching the guest operating system; DynamoDB (A), RDS (C), and S3 (D) are managed services where AWS handles all underlying OS patching.

cards.q: Which Amazon S3 storage class is MOST cost-effective for unknown access patterns?
options: S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)
cards.explanation: S3 Intelligent-Tiering automatically moves objects between access tiers based on changing access patterns with no retrieval fees, making it ideal when access patterns are unpredictable; Standard-IA (B) charges retrieval fees and is suboptimal if access patterns are truly unknown.

cards.q: Which options are AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) security perspective capabilities? (Choose two.)
cards.a: C. Incident response ; D. Infrastructure protection
cards.explanation: Incident response (C) and infrastructure protection (D) are explicitly listed as Security perspective capabilities in the AWS CAF; observability (A) and incident/problem management (B) belong to the Operations perspective.

cards.q: A company has a managed IAM policy that does not grant the necessary permissions for users to accomplish required tasks. How can this be resolved?
options: Use a third-party web application firewall (WAF) managed rule from the AWS Marketplace.
Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to create a customer-managed key.
cards.a: B. Create a custom IAM policy.
cards.explanation: Creating a custom IAM policy allows defining the exact permissions needed for the specific tasks; AWS Shield (A), WAF rules (C), and KMS keys (D) are security services unrelated to IAM permission management.

cards.q: Who is responsible for managing IAM user access and secret keys according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: IAM access and secret keys are static, so there is no need to rotate them.
The customer is responsible for rotating keys.
AWS will rotate the keys whenever required.
The AWS Support team will rotate keys when requested by the customer.
cards.a: B. The customer is responsible for rotating keys.
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C ("AWS will rotate the keys"), but per the AWS shared responsibility model, the customer is responsible for rotating their own IAM access keys (B).

cards.q: Which AWS Cloud benefit gives a company the ability to quickly deploy cloud resources to access compute, storage, and database infrastructures in a matter of minutes?
cards.explanation: Agility in cloud computing refers to the ability to rapidly provision and deprovision resources (compute, storage, databases) in minutes rather than weeks; elasticity (A) specifically describes automatic scaling to match demand, not the speed of resource provisioning.

cards.q: Which of the following is entirely the responsibility of AWS, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: Development of an IAM password policy
Patching of the guest operating system
cards.explanation: Physical and environmental controls (building security, power, cooling, fire suppression) are entirely AWS's responsibility; security training (A), IAM password policies (B), and guest OS patching (C) are all customer responsibilities.

cards.q: Which of the following is a characteristic of the AWS account root user?
options: The root user is the only user that can be configured with multi-factor authentication (MFA).
The root user is the only user that can access the AWS Management Console.
The root user is the first sign-in identity that is available when an AWS account is created.
The root user has a password that cannot be changed.
cards.a: C. The root user is the first sign-in identity that is available when an AWS account is created.
cards.explanation: The root user is the first identity created when an AWS account is opened, with full unrestricted access; any IAM user can be configured with MFA (A is false), and the root password can be changed (D is false).

cards.q: An Amazon EC2 instance previously used for development is inaccessible and no longer appears in the AWS Management Console. Which AWS service should be used to determine what action made this EC2 instance inaccessible?
cards.explanation: AWS CloudTrail logs all API calls including EC2 TerminateInstances and StopInstances, recording who performed the action, when, and from where; CloudWatch Logs (A) captures application and system logs but does not track AWS API calls.

cards.q: A company's application developers need to quickly provision and manage AWS services by using scripts. Which AWS offering should the developers use to meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: The AWS CLI enables developers to script and automate AWS service provisioning and management through command-line commands; AWS CodeBuild (B) compiles source code and runs tests but is not a general-purpose AWS management tool.

cards.q: A company wants to migrate unstructured data to AWS. The data needs to be securely moved with inflight encryption and end-to-end data validation. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: AWS DataSync provides automated, secure data transfer with in-flight TLS encryption and end-to-end data integrity validation (checksums); AWS Application Migration Service (A) migrates servers/applications, not unstructured data files.

cards.q: A company wants to quickly implement a continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: AWS CodeStar provides a unified interface to quickly set up a complete CI/CD pipeline (CodeCommit, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodePipeline) with project templates; AWS Config (A) tracks resource configurations and has no CI/CD capabilities.

cards.q: Which AWS Cloud deployment model uses AWS Outposts as part of the application deployment infrastructure?
cards.explanation: Hybrid cloud deployment uses AWS Outposts to run AWS infrastructure on-premises alongside existing data center workloads, bridging on-premises and cloud environments; serverless (B) and cloud-native (C) deployments run entirely in the AWS cloud.

cards.q: Which of the following is a fully managed graph database service on AWS?
cards.explanation: Amazon Neptune is a fully managed graph database service supporting property graph (Gremlin) and RDF (SPARQL) query models; Amazon Aurora (A) is a relational database and DynamoDB (C) is a key-value/document database - neither supports graph queries.

cards.q: Which AWS service could an administrator use to provide desktop environments for several employees?
cards.explanation: Amazon WorkSpaces is a fully managed Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) that provisions cloud-based Windows or Linux virtual desktops for employees; AWS Fargate (B) is a serverless container engine with no desktop environment capability.

cards.q: Which type of AWS storage is ephemeral and is deleted when an Amazon EC2 instance is stopped or terminated?
cards.explanation: EC2 instance store volumes are physically attached to the host machine and all data is lost when the instance is stopped, terminated, or the underlying host fails; EBS volumes (A) persist independently of the instance lifecycle.

cards.q: A company wants to provide access to Windows file shares in AWS from its on-premises workloads. The company does not want to provision any additional infrastructure or applications in its data center. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: Amazon FSx File Gateway provides on-premises Windows workloads with low-latency SMB access to fully managed FSx for Windows File Server shares in AWS, requiring no additional on-premises infrastructure; AWS DataSync (B) is a migration tool, not a continuous file-sharing gateway.

cards.q: An ecommerce company wants to use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling to add and remove EC2 instances based on CPU utilization. Which AWS service or feature can initiate an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling action to achieve this goal?
cards.explanation: Amazon CloudWatch alarms monitor metrics like CPU utilization and trigger Auto Scaling policies when thresholds are breached; Amazon SNS (B) delivers notifications but does not directly initiate Auto Scaling actions based on metrics.

cards.q: A company wants to transform its workforce by attracting and developing a digitally fluent high-performance workforce. The company wants to attract a diverse and inclusive workforce with appropriate mix of technical and non-technical skills. Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: The People perspective of the AWS CAF addresses workforce transformation, including attracting digitally fluent talent, building diverse teams, and developing cloud skills; the Business perspective (A) focuses on strategy and outcomes, not workforce development.

cards.q: A company wants to move its on-premises databases to managed cloud database services by using a simplified migration process. Which AWS service or tool can help the company meet this requirement?
cards.a: D. AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS)
cards.explanation: AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) is purpose-built for migrating databases to AWS managed services with minimal downtime and simplified setup; AWS Application Migration Service (B) migrates entire servers, not specifically database workloads.

cards.q: A company needs a fully managed file server that natively supports Microsoft workloads and file systems. The file server must also support the SMB protocol. Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
options: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
cards.a: C. Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
cards.explanation: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is a fully managed native Windows file system that natively supports SMB protocol and Windows features (Active Directory, DFS); Amazon EFS (A) supports only NFS protocol for Linux workloads.

cards.q: A company has been storing monthly reports in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company exports the report data into comma-separated values (.csv) files. A developer wants to write a simple query that can read all of these files and generate a summary report. Which AWS service or feature should the developer use to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?
cards.explanation: Amazon Athena is a serverless query service that runs SQL directly against CSV/JSON/Parquet files in S3 with zero infrastructure management; Amazon Redshift (C) requires provisioning a data warehouse cluster, adding significant operational overhead.

cards.q: Which AWS feature provides a no-cost platform for AWS users to join community groups, ask questions, find answers, and read community-generated articles about best practices?
cards.explanation: AWS re:Post is a free community-driven Q&A service where AWS users can ask questions, share knowledge, and read best-practice articles; AWS Knowledge Center (A) contains curated FAQ articles but is not an interactive community forum.

cards.q: A company needs to search for text in documents that are stored in Amazon S3. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: Amazon Kendra is an intelligent enterprise search service powered by ML that can index and search text within documents stored in S3; Amazon Rekognition (B) analyzes images and video, not text documents.

cards.q: Which AWS services make use of global edge locations? (Choose two.)
cards.a: B. Amazon CloudFront ; C. AWS Global Accelerator
cards.explanation: Amazon CloudFront (B) caches content at 400+ global edge locations, and AWS Global Accelerator (C) routes traffic through edge locations to the AWS backbone; AWS Fargate (A) and Amazon VPC (E) operate within Regions, not at edge locations.

cards.q: A user needs a relational database but does not have the resources to manage the hardware, resiliency, and replication. Which AWS service option meets the user's requirements?
options: Run MySQL on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS).
cards.a: C. Choose Amazon RDS for MySQL.
cards.explanation: Amazon RDS for MySQL is a fully managed relational database service that handles hardware provisioning, patching, backups, replication, and failover; running MySQL on EC2 (B) requires the customer to manage all of those tasks manually.

cards.q: Which mechanism allows developers to access AWS services from application code?
cards.explanation: The AWS SDK provides language-specific libraries (Python, Java, .NET, Go, etc.) that enable developers to call AWS service APIs directly from application code; the Management Console (B) is a web GUI, not a programmatic interface for application code.

cards.q: A company is migrating to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to understand and identify potential security misconfigurations or unexpected behaviors. The company wants to prioritize any protective controls it might need. Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) security perspective capability will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: The Threat detection capability within the Security perspective focuses on identifying potential security misconfigurations, unexpected behaviors, and understanding protective controls needed; Identity and access management (A) focuses on authentication and authorization, not behavioral threat identification.

cards.q: Which AWS services or features give users the ability to create a network connection between two VPCs? (Choose two.)
cards.a: C. VPC peering ; E. AWS Transit Gateway
cards.explanation: VPC peering (C) creates a direct network route between two VPCs, and AWS Transit Gateway (E) connects multiple VPCs through a central hub; VPC endpoints (A) connect a VPC to an AWS service endpoint, not to another VPC.

cards.q: Which AWS service converts text to lifelike voices?
cards.explanation: Amazon Polly converts text input into natural-sounding speech using deep learning; Amazon Transcribe (A) does the reverse, converting speech to text.

cards.q: A company wants to use application stacks to run a workload in the AWS Cloud. The company wants to use pre-configured instances. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: Amazon Lightsail offers pre-configured application stacks (WordPress, LAMP, Node.js, etc.) with fixed monthly pricing and simplified management; Amazon EC2 (D) requires manually configuring and assembling all components.

cards.q: Which AWS services are supported by Savings Plans? (Choose two.)
cards.a: A. Amazon EC2 ; C. Amazon SageMaker
cards.explanation: Compute Savings Plans and EC2 Instance Savings Plans cover Amazon EC2 (A), and SageMaker Savings Plans cover Amazon SageMaker (C); Amazon RDS (B), Redshift (D), and DynamoDB (E) are not covered by Savings Plans.

cards.q: Which AWS service or tool can provide rightsizing recommendations for Amazon EC2 resources at no additional cost?
cards.explanation: AWS Cost Explorer includes built-in rightsizing recommendations for EC2 instances at no additional cost, based on CloudWatch utilization data; the Well-Architected Tool (A) reviews architecture against best practices but does not generate instance-specific sizing recommendations.

cards.q: A company operates a petabyte-scale data warehouse to analyze its data. The company wants a solution that will not require manual hardware and software management. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: Amazon Redshift is a fully managed petabyte-scale data warehouse with no hardware or software management required; Amazon DocumentDB (A) is a document database and Amazon Neptune (C) is a graph database, neither designed for data warehousing.

cards.q: A library wants to automate the classification of electronic books based on the contents of the books. Which AWS service should the library use to meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: Amazon Comprehend is an NLP service that uses ML to extract insights, classify text by content/sentiment, and identify topics within documents; Amazon Redshift (A) is a data warehouse with no NLP or text classification capability.

cards.q: Which task is a responsibility of AWS, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
cards.a: C. Protection of physical network infrastructure
cards.explanation: Protection of physical network infrastructure (routers, switches, cabling in data centers) is entirely AWS's responsibility; encryption of application data (A) and configuration of firewalls (D) are customer responsibilities.

cards.q: Which options are AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) cloud transformation journey recommendations? (Choose two.)
cards.a: A. Envision phase ; B. Align phase
cards.explanation: The AWS CAF cloud transformation journey has four phases: Envision (A), Align (B), Launch, and Scale; Assess (C), Mobilize (D), and Migrate and modernize (E) are phases of the AWS Migration Framework, not the CAF transformation journey.

cards.q: A company wants to generate a list of IAM users. The company also wants to view the status of various credentials that are associated with the users, such as password, access keys, and multi-factor authentication (MFA) devices. Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements?
options: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer
cards.explanation: The IAM credential report is a downloadable CSV listing all IAM users and the status of their credentials (passwords, access keys, MFA devices); IAM Access Analyzer (C) identifies externally shared resources, not user credential status.

cards.q: A company is designing its AWS workloads so that components can be updated regularly and so that changes can be made in small, reversible increments. Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework does this design support?
cards.explanation: Operational Excellence explicitly promotes making frequent, small, reversible changes to workloads, enabling rapid iteration with limited blast radius; Performance Efficiency (B) focuses on efficient resource use, not change management practices.

cards.q: A company wants to track tags, buckets, and prefixes for its Amazon S3 objects. Which S3 feature will meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: S3 Inventory reports provide a scheduled CSV or ORC listing of all objects in a bucket with their metadata including tags, storage class, and prefix; S3 Lifecycle (B) manages transitions/expirations but does not produce inventory listings.

cards.q: A company wants to allow users to authenticate and authorize multiple AWS accounts by using a single set of credentials. Which AWS service or resource will meet this requirement?
options: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
cards.a: C. AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
cards.explanation: AWS IAM Identity Center (formerly AWS SSO) enables centralized authentication across multiple AWS accounts using a single set of credentials; AWS Organizations (A) manages account structure and policies but does not provide user-level SSO authentication.

cards.q: A company wants to use the AWS Cloud to deploy an application globally. Which architecture deployment model should the company use to meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: A Multi-Region deployment distributes the application across multiple geographic locations worldwide, enabling global availability and low latency; Multi-AZ (C) provides high availability within a single Region, not global deployment.

cards.q: A company wants a web application to interact with various AWS services. Which AWS service or resource will meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (AWS Management Console), which is a web UI for humans, not typically how web applications interact with AWS services. Web applications typically use the AWS SDK (not listed).

cards.q: A company is migrating its applications from on-premises to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to ensure that the applications are assigned only the minimum permissions that are needed to perform all operations. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.a: A. AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (Amazon CloudWatch), but CloudWatch monitors performance metrics, not permissions. AWS IAM (A) is the standard service for managing permissions with least privilege.

cards.q: Which options are AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) governance perspective capabilities? (Choose two.)
cards.a: B. Cloud financial management ; C. Application portfolio management
cards.explanation: The Governance perspective capabilities include cloud financial management (B) and application portfolio management (C); identity and access management (A) belongs to the Security perspective, and innovation management (D) and product management (E) belong to the Business perspective.

cards.q: Which AWS service provides a single location to track the progress of application migrations?
cards.explanation: AWS Migration Hub provides a single location to track the progress of application migrations across multiple AWS and partner migration tools; AWS Application Discovery Service (A) collects on-premises data but does not centrally track migration progress.

cards.q: A company launched an Amazon EC2 instance with the latest Amazon Linux 2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI). Which actions can a system administrator take to connect to the EC2 instance? (Choose two.)
options: Use a Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) connection.
Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager.
cards.a: A. Use Amazon EC2 Instance Connect. ; D. Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager.
