cards.q: Why are AWS CloudFormation templates used?
options: To reduce provisioning time by using automation.
To transfer existing infrastructure to another company.
To reuse on-premises infrastructure in the AWS Cloud.
To deploy large infrastructure with no cost implications.
cards.a: A. To reduce provisioning time by using automation.
cards.explanation: CloudFormation templates enable automated, repeatable infrastructure provisioning, reducing deployment time from hours/days to minutes; they do not eliminate cost (D) or transfer infrastructure to other companies (B).

cards.q: A company is using AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Who can manage the access keys of the AWS account root user?
options: IAM users in the same account that have been granted permission
IAM roles in any account that have been granted permission
IAM users and roles that have been granted permission
cards.explanation: Only the AWS account owner (root user) can manage root account access keys; IAM users and roles (A, B, C) cannot manage root credentials regardless of their permissions.

cards.q: Which group shares responsibility with AWS for security and compliance of AWS accounts and resources?
cards.explanation: Under the shared responsibility model, customers share responsibility with AWS for the security and compliance of their AWS accounts and resources.

cards.q: A company wants to run relationship databases in the AWS Cloud. The company wants to use a managed service that will install the database and run regular software updates. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: Amazon RDS is a fully managed relational database service that handles installation, patching, backups, and software updates; Amazon S3 (A) is object storage and DynamoDB (D) is NoSQL, neither is a managed relational database.

cards.q: A company's cloud environment includes Amazon EC2 instances and Application Load Balancers. The company wants to improve protections for its cloud resources against DDoS attacks. The company also wants to have real-time visibility into any DDoS attacks. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (AWS Firewall Manager), but Firewall Manager centrally manages security policies. AWS Shield Advanced (C) provides DDoS protection with real-time visibility and DDoS response team access.

cards.q: Which task is the responsibility of AWS, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: Apply guest operating system patches to Amazon EC2 instances.
Provide monitoring of human resources information management (HRIM) systems.
Perform automated backups of Amazon RDS instances.
Optimize the costs of running AWS services.
cards.a: C. Perform automated backups of Amazon RDS instances.
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (HRIM monitoring), but AWS does not monitor customers' HR systems. Performing automated backups of RDS instances (C) is an AWS responsibility.

cards.q: A user needs to perform a one-time backup of an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that is attached to an Amazon EC2 instance. What is the MOST operationally efficient way to perform this backup?
options: Attach another EBS volume to the EC2 instance, and copy the contents.
Copy the EBS volume to a server that is running outside AWS and is connected with AWS Direct Connect.
Create an EBS snapshot of the volume.
Create a custom script to copy the EBS file contents to Amazon S3.
cards.a: C. Create an EBS snapshot of the volume.
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (copy to external server), but creating an EBS snapshot (C) is the most operationally efficient one-click backup method.

cards.q: A developer who has no AWS Cloud experience wants to use AWS technology to build a web application. Which AWS service should the developer use to start building the application?
cards.explanation: Amazon Lightsail provides pre-configured stacks, simplified management, and fixed monthly pricing, making it ideal for developers without AWS Cloud experience; Amazon SageMaker (A) is a complex ML platform unsuitable for beginners building web apps.

cards.q: A company wants to manage access and permissions for its third-party software as a service (SaaS) applications. The company wants to use a portal where end users can access assigned AWS accounts and AWS Cloud applications. Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
options: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory
cards.a: B. AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (IAM), but IAM does not provide an end-user portal for SaaS applications. AWS IAM Identity Center (B) provides the centralized SSO portal for multiple AWS accounts and cloud applications.

cards.q: A company wants to add a conversational chatbot to its website. Which AWS service can the company use to meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: Amazon Lex builds conversational chatbot interfaces using voice and text, powered by the same technology as Alexa; Amazon Textract (A) extracts text from documents, not conversational AI.

cards.q: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective focuses on organizing an inventory of data products in a data catalog?
cards.explanation: The Platform perspective of the AWS CAF includes data architecture and data engineering capabilities, which encompasses organizing data products in a data catalog; the Governance perspective (B) covers financial and portfolio management.

cards.q: A company runs its production workload in the AWS Cloud. The company needs to choose one of the AWS Support Plans. Which of the AWS Support Plans will meet these requirements at the LOWEST cost?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (Enterprise), but Enterprise is the most expensive plan. Business Support (D) is the lowest-cost plan recommended for production workloads.

cards.q: What is the primary use case for Amazon GuardDuty?
options: Automatic monitoring for threats to AWS workloads
cards.a: C. Automatic monitoring for threats to AWS workloads
cards.explanation: Amazon GuardDuty continuously monitors AWS accounts and workloads for threats using ML, anomaly detection, and integrated threat intelligence; AWS WAF (B) protects against web application attacks but does not provide broad threat monitoring.

cards.q: Which VPC component can a company use to set up a virtual firewall at the Amazon EC2 instance level?
cards.explanation: Security groups operate at the EC2 instance (ENI) level as a virtual firewall, controlling inbound and outbound traffic; Network ACLs (A) operate at the subnet level, not the instance level.

cards.q: A developer needs to interact with AWS by using the AWS CLI. Which security feature or AWS service must be provisioned in the developer's account to meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (Systems Manager), but the standard requirement for CLI access is an AWS access key (D).

cards.q: A company wants to set up a secure network connection from on premises to the AWS Cloud within 1 week. Which solution will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: AWS Site-to-Site VPN can be set up within hours or days, providing an encrypted tunnel over the internet; AWS Direct Connect (A) requires physical circuit provisioning that typically takes weeks to months.

cards.q: What is a customer responsibility under the AWS shared responsibility model when using AWS Lambda?
options: Maintenance of the underlying Lambda hardware.
Maintenance of the Lambda networking infrastructure.
The code and libraries that run in the Lambda functions.
cards.a: C. The code and libraries that run in the Lambda functions.
cards.explanation: For Lambda (serverless), the customer is responsible only for the code and libraries running inside the function; AWS manages the underlying hardware (A), networking (B), and server software (D).

cards.q: Which tasks are the responsibility of AWS according to the AWS shared responsibility model? (Choose two.)
options: Configure AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).
Configure security groups on Amazon EC2 instances.
Secure the access of physical AWS facilities.
Patch applications that run on Amazon EC2 instances.
cards.a: C. Secure the access of physical AWS facilities. ; E. Perform infrastructure patching and maintenance.
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed DE, but D (Patch applications on EC2) is the customer's responsibility. AWS responsibilities should be C (Secure physical facilities) and E (Infrastructure patching).

cards.q: Which AWS network services or features allow CIDR block notation when providing an IP address range? (Choose two.)
cards.a: A. Security groups ; C. Network access control list (network ACL)
cards.explanation: Security groups (A) and Network ACLs (C) both use CIDR block notation for specifying IP address ranges in their rules; AMIs (B), Budgets (D), and EBS (E) do not use CIDR notation.

cards.q: A company wants to develop an accessibility application that will convert text into audible speech. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: Amazon Polly converts text into natural-sounding audible speech using deep learning; Amazon MQ (A) is a managed message broker service with no text-to-speech capability.

cards.q: A company needs to set up dedicated network connectivity between its on-premises data center and the AWS Cloud. The network cannot use the public internet. Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (AWS VPN), but VPN tunnels traverse the public internet (encrypted). AWS Direct Connect (D) is the service that provides a dedicated connection without using the public internet.

cards.q: A company wants to migrate its on-premises infrastructure to the AWS Cloud. Which advantage of cloud computing will help the company reduce upfront costs?
options: Benefit from massive economies of scale
Trade fixed expense for variable expense
cards.a: D. Trade fixed expense for variable expense
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (economies of scale), but the question specifically asks about reducing "upfront costs." Trading fixed expense for variable expense (D) directly eliminates upfront capital expenditure.

cards.q: Which AWS service is used to temporarily provide federated security credentials to access AWS resources?
cards.a: B. AWS Simple Token Service (AWS STS)
cards.explanation: AWS Security Token Service (STS) issues temporary, limited-privilege security credentials for federated users or cross-account access; AWS Secrets Manager (C) stores application secrets but does not issue temporary security tokens for AWS API access.

cards.q: What is a benefit of using an Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) load balancer with applications running in the AWS Cloud?
options: An ELB will automatically scale resources to meet capacity needs.
An ELB can balance traffic across multiple compute resources.
An ELB can span multiple AWS Regions.
An ELB can balance traffic between multiple internet gateways.
cards.a: B. An ELB can balance traffic across multiple compute resources.
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (ELB spanning multiple Regions), but ELBs operate within a single Region. The correct answer is B (balance traffic across multiple compute resources).

cards.q: A company needs to convert video files and audio files to a format that will play on smartphones. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: Amazon Elastic Transcoder converts media files (video and audio) into formats optimized for playback on smartphones and other devices; Amazon Comprehend (A) is an NLP service with no media transcoding capability.

cards.q: A company wants to securely store Amazon RDS database credentials and automatically rotate user passwords periodically. Which AWS service or capability will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (Parameter Store), but Parameter Store does not support automatic password rotation. AWS Secrets Manager (C) natively supports automatic credential rotation.

cards.q: A company needs to have the ability to set up infrastructure for new applications in minutes. Which advantage of cloud computing will help the company meet this requirement?
options: Trade fixed expense for variable expense
cards.explanation: "Increase speed and agility" describes the ability to provision new infrastructure in minutes rather than weeks, enabling rapid application development; "trade fixed for variable" (A) describes pricing, not speed of deployment.

cards.q: Which tasks are responsibilities of the customer, according to the AWS shared responsibility model? (Choose two.)
options: Encrypt data and maintain data integrity.
Patch the Amazon RDS operating system.
Maintain identity and access management controls.
cards.a: B. Encrypt data and maintain data integrity. ; D. Maintain identity and access management controls.
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed BC, but C (Patch the Amazon RDS operating system) is AWS's responsibility for managed RDS. The customer responsibilities should be B (Encrypt data) and D (Maintain IAM controls).

cards.q: An online retail company wants to migrate its on-premises workload to AWS. The company needs to automatically handle a seasonal workload increase in a cost-effective manner. Which AWS Cloud features will help the company meet this requirement? (Choose two.)
cards.a: B. Pay-as-you-go pricing ; D. Auto Scaling policies
cards.explanation: Pay-as-you-go pricing (B) ensures the company only pays for resources used during seasonal peaks, and Auto Scaling policies (D) automatically adjust capacity to meet demand; Cross-Region deployment (A) adds cost without addressing seasonality.

cards.q: A developer needs to use a standardized template to create copies of a company's AWS architecture for development, test, and production environments. Which AWS service should the developer use to meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (CloudFront), but CloudFront is a CDN. AWS CloudFormation (B) uses templates to create standardized, repeatable infrastructure environments.

cards.q: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, which of the following is a responsibility of the customer?
options: Shred disk drives before they leave a data center.
Prevent customers from gathering packets or collecting traffic at the hypervisor level.
Patch the guest operating system with the latest security patches.
Maintain security systems that provide physical monitoring of data centers.
cards.a: C. Patch the guest operating system with the latest security patches.
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed D (Maintain physical monitoring systems), but physical security is AWS's responsibility. Patching the guest OS (C) is the standard customer responsibility.

cards.q: Which AWS service uses speech-to-text conversion to help users create meeting notes?
cards.explanation: Amazon Transcribe uses speech-to-text conversion to convert audio recordings into text, enabling automated meeting note creation; Amazon Polly (A) does the reverse, converting text to speech.

cards.q: A company has a workload that will run continuously for 1 year. The workload cannot tolerate service interruptions. Which Amazon EC2 purchasing option will be MOST cost-effective?
cards.explanation: All Upfront Reserved Instances for 1 year provide the maximum discount for a continuous, uninterruptible workload; Partial Upfront (B) offers a slightly lower discount, and On-Demand (D) is the most expensive option.

cards.q: A company migrated its systems to the AWS Cloud. The systems are rightsized, and a security review did not reveal any issues. The company must ensure that additional developments, integrations, changes, and system usage growth do not jeopardize this optimized AWS infrastructure. Which AWS service should the company use to report ongoing optimization and security?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed D (Systems Manager), but Trusted Advisor (A) provides ongoing optimization and security recommendations across five categories.

cards.q: Which AWS service integrates with other AWS services to provide the ability to encrypt data at rest?
cards.a: A. AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS)
cards.explanation: AWS KMS creates and manages encryption keys that integrate natively with services like EBS, S3, and RDS to encrypt data at rest; AWS Certificate Manager (B) manages SSL/TLS certificates for data in transit, not at-rest encryption.

cards.q: A company is migrating to the AWS Cloud instead of running its infrastructure on premises. Which of the following are advantages of this migration? (Choose two.)
options: Elimination of the need to perform security auditing
Ability to deploy globally in minutes
Elimination of the cost of IT staff members
Redundancy by default for all compute services
cards.a: B. Increased global reach and agility ; C. Ability to deploy globally in minutes
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed AD, but D (Elimination of IT staff costs) is not a realistic cloud benefit. The correct advantages should be B (Increased global reach and agility) and C (Ability to deploy globally in minutes).

cards.q: A company wants to securely access an Amazon S3 bucket from an Amazon EC2 instance without accessing the internet. What should the company use to accomplish this goal?
cards.explanation: A VPC endpoint provides private connectivity between a VPC and S3 without traversing the internet; an internet gateway (B) and NAT gateway (D) both route traffic through the internet.

cards.q: A company wants an AWS service that can automate software deployment in Amazon EC2 instances and on-premises instances. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (CodeBuild), but CodeBuild compiles source code and runs tests. AWS CodeDeploy (C) automates software deployment to EC2 and on-premises instances.

cards.q: Which AWS services are serverless? (Choose two.)
options: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka
cards.a: A. AWS Fargate ; D. Amazon S3
cards.explanation: AWS Fargate (A) is serverless container compute and Amazon S3 (D) is serverless object storage, both requiring no infrastructure management; Amazon EC2 (E) and EMR (C) require managing underlying instances.

cards.q: Which of the following is a customer responsibility according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: Apply security patches for Amazon S3 infrastructure devices.
Provide physical security for AWS datacenters.
Install operating system updates on Lambda@Edge.
Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) for IAM user accounts.
cards.a: D. Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) for IAM user accounts.
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (Install OS updates on Lambda@Edge), but Lambda@Edge is fully managed by AWS including OS updates. Implementing MFA for IAM users (D) is the standard customer responsibility.

cards.q: A company needs to run some of its workloads on premises to comply with regulatory guidelines. The company wants to use the AWS Cloud to run workloads that are not required to be on premises. The company also wants to be able to use the same API calls for the on-premises workloads and the cloud workloads. Which AWS service or feature should the company use to meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed D (AWS Wavelength), but Wavelength deploys at telecom edges for mobile latency. AWS Outposts (B) runs AWS infrastructure on-premises with the same APIs as the cloud.

cards.q: What is the recommended use case for Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances?
options: A steady-state workload that requires a particular EC2 instance configuration for a long period of time
A workload that can be interrupted for a project that requires the lowest possible cost
An unpredictable workload that does not require a long-term commitment
A workload that is expected to run for longer than 1 year
cards.a: C. An unpredictable workload that does not require a long-term commitment
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (interruptible workload needing lowest cost), but that describes Spot Instances. On-Demand is recommended for unpredictable workloads without long-term commitment (C).

cards.q: To assist companies with Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance in the cloud, AWS provides:
options: physical Inspections of data centers by appointment.
required PCI compliance certifications for any application running on AWS.
an AWS Attestation of Compliance (AOC) report for specific AWS services.
cards.a: C. an AWS Attestation of Compliance (AOC) report for specific AWS services.
cards.explanation: AWS provides an Attestation of Compliance (AOC) report for specific AWS services that demonstrates PCI DSS compliance; AWS does not provide blanket PCI certifications for customer applications (B) or allow physical data center inspections (A).

cards.q: In which situations should a company create an IAM user instead of an IAM role?
options: When an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances requires access to other AWS services
When the company creates AWS access credentials for individuals
When the company creates an application that runs on a mobile phone that makes requests to AWS
When the company needs to add users to IAM groups
When users are authenticated in the corporate network and want to be able to use AWS without having to sign in a second time
cards.a: B. When the company creates AWS access credentials for individuals
cards.explanation: IAM users are created when a company needs to provide individuals with their own permanent credentials (passwords, access keys) for AWS access; IAM roles (not users) should be used for EC2 applications (A) and federated access (E).

cards.q: A company hosts a web application on AWS. The company has improved the availability of its application by provisioning multiple Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to distribute its traffic across the EC2 instances while providing a single point of contact to the web clients. Which AWS service can distribute the traffic to multiple EC2 instances as targets?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (NAT gateway), but NAT gateways handle outbound traffic for private subnets. Application Load Balancer (B) distributes incoming traffic across multiple EC2 targets with a single DNS endpoint.

cards.q: What is the total volume of data that can be stored in Amazon S3?
cards.explanation: Amazon S3 storage is virtually unlimited with no cap on total volume; individual objects can be up to 5 TB, but the total bucket/account storage has no practical limit.

cards.q: Which design principle is related to the reliability pillar according to the AWS Well-Architected Framework?
cards.explanation: "Test recovery procedures" is an explicit Reliability pillar design principle that ensures systems can recover from disruptions; "experiment more often" (B) is a Performance Efficiency principle.

cards.q: A company stores data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Which task is the responsibility of AWS?
options: Protect the infrastructure that supports S3 storage.
cards.a: D. Protect the infrastructure that supports S3 storage.
cards.explanation: Protecting the infrastructure that supports S3 storage (physical hardware, networking, facilities) is AWS's responsibility; configuring Lifecycle policies (A), Versioning (B), and bucket policies (C) are all customer responsibilities.

cards.q: A company deployed an application in multiple AWS Regions around the world. The company wants to improve the application's performance and availability. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (Amazon DataZone), but DataZone is a data governance/sharing service. AWS Global Accelerator (A) improves global application performance and availability.

cards.q: A company needs stateless network filtering for its VPC. Which AWS service, tool, or feature will meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: Network ACLs are stateless network filters that operate at the subnet level within a VPC; security groups (B) are stateful, and AWS WAF (D) operates at the application layer (Layer 7), not the network layer.

cards.q: Which option is an advantage of AWS Cloud computing that minimizes variable costs?
cards.explanation: Economies of scale from AWS's massive aggregate demand result in lower per-unit costs passed to all customers, minimizing variable costs; high availability (A) and agility (D) are operational benefits, not cost-minimization mechanisms.

cards.q: A company has data lakes designed for high performance computing (HPC) workloads. Which Amazon EC2 instance type should the company use to meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: Storage optimized instances (D-family, I-family) are designed for workloads requiring high sequential read/write access to large datasets on local storage, making them ideal for HPC data lakes; compute optimized (B) focuses on CPU-intensive tasks without storage emphasis.

cards.q: Which benefits does a company gain when the company moves from on-premises IT architecture to the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)
options: Reduced or eliminated tasks for hardware troubleshooting, capacity planning, and procurement
Elimination of the need for trained IT staff
Automatic security configuration of all applications that are migrated to the cloud
Elimination of the need for disaster recovery planning
Faster deployment of new features and applications
cards.a: A. Reduced or eliminated tasks for hardware troubleshooting, capacity planning, and procurement ; E. Faster deployment of new features and applications
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed AC, but C (Automatic security configuration) is not a cloud benefit; security remains a shared responsibility. Correct should be A (Reduced hardware tasks) and E (Faster deployment).

cards.q: A company is planning to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company is conducting organizational transformation and wants to become more responsive to customer inquiries and feedback. Which task should the company perform to meet these requirements, according to the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF)? (Choose two.)
options: Realign teams to focus on products and value streams.
Create new value propositions with new products and services.
Use agile methods to rapidly iterate and evolve.
Use a new data and analytics platform to create actionable insights.
cards.a: B. Create new value propositions with new products and services.
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (Create new value propositions), which aligns with the Business perspective's innovation management for becoming more responsive to customers.

cards.q: A company that is planning to migrate to the AWS Cloud is based in an isolated area that has limited internet connectivity. The company needs to perform local data processing on premises. The company needs a solution that can operate without a stable internet connection. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed D (AWS Backup), but AWS Backup requires internet connectivity to AWS. AWS Snowball Edge (B) has local compute and storage that operates without internet.

cards.q: A company wants to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company needs the ability to acquire resources when the resources are necessary. The company also needs the ability to release those resources when the resources are no longer necessary. Which architecture concept of the AWS Cloud meets these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (Availability), but the description (acquire when needed, release when not) is the definition of Elasticity (A).

cards.q: A company wants to deploy a web application as a containerized application. The company wants to use a managed service that can automatically create container images from source code and deploy the containerized application. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: AWS App Runner automatically builds container images from source code or container registries and deploys them as a fully managed service; Amazon ECS (B) requires more configuration for image building and deployment management.

cards.q: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective focuses on real-time insights and answers questions about strategy?
cards.explanation: The Business perspective of the AWS CAF provides real-time insights into strategy management and addresses how cloud initiatives create business value; the Operations perspective (A) focuses on service delivery management.

cards.q: A company wants to build, train, and deploy machine learning (ML) models. Which AWS service can the company use to meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (Amazon Forecast), but Forecast is specifically for time-series forecasting. Amazon SageMaker (D) is the comprehensive service for building, training, and deploying ML models.

cards.q: Which AWS service or tool provides recommendations to help users get rightsized Amazon EC2 instances based on historical workload usage data?
cards.explanation: AWS Compute Optimizer analyzes historical workload utilization data and recommends optimal EC2 instance types and sizes; AWS Pricing Calculator (A) estimates costs for new architectures but does not analyze existing workload data.

cards.q: A company plans to migrate its application from on premises to the AWS Cloud. The company needs to gather usage and configuration data for the application components. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (AWS Transfer Family), but Transfer Family provides managed SFTP/FTP endpoints. AWS Application Discovery Service (C) gathers usage and configuration data from on-premises environments.

cards.q: Which design principle aligns with performance efficiency pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework?
cards.explanation: "Using serverless architectures" is a Performance Efficiency design principle that lets developers focus on application logic while AWS manages infrastructure optimization; measuring cost (C) belongs to the Cost Optimization pillar.

cards.q: A company wants to provide low latency to its users around the world. Which feature of the AWS Cloud meet this requirement?
cards.explanation: AWS's global infrastructure (Regions, AZs, edge locations in 30+ countries) allows deploying applications close to users anywhere in the world, reducing latency; pay-as-you-go (B) is a pricing model unrelated to latency.

cards.q: Which type of workload should a company run on Amazon EC2 Spot Instances?
options: A steady-state workload that requires a particular EC2 instance configuration for a long period of time
A workload that can be interrupted and can control costs
A steady-state workload that does not require a long-term commitment
A workload that cannot be interrupted and can control costs
cards.a: B. A workload that can be interrupted and can control costs
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (steady-state, no commitment), but that describes On-Demand Instances. Spot Instances are for interruptible workloads that can control costs (B).

cards.q: For which use case are Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances MOST cost-effective?
options: Compute-intensive video transcoding that can be restarted if necessary
An instance in continual use for 1 month to conduct quality assurance tests
An instance that runs a web server that will run for 1 year
An instance that runs a database that will run for 3 years
cards.a: B. An instance in continual use for 1 month to conduct quality assurance tests
cards.explanation: A 1-month workload for testing is ideal for On-Demand Instances because it avoids commitment; Reserved Instances (C, D) require 1-3 year commitments that would be wasteful for a 1-month need.

cards.q: A company has developed a new In-house application. The company does not have a way to determine or predict the usage demand that the application will create. Which AWS Cloud computing benefit is the company seeking?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (Secure), but the question describes unpredictable demand needing to scale. The correct cloud benefit is D (Scalable and high performance).

cards.q: A company plans to onboard new employees that will be working remotely. The company needs to set up Windows virtual desktops to create a working environment for the new employees. The employees must be able access the working environment from anywhere and by using their computer or a web browser. Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: Amazon WorkSpaces provides fully managed Windows or Linux virtual desktops accessible from any device (computer, tablet, or web browser) from anywhere; AWS Global Accelerator (B) optimizes network routing, not virtual desktop delivery.

cards.q: A company purchased Amazon EC2 Standard Reserved Instances (RIs) for a workload in the AWS Cloud. The company needs to move part of the workload to an instance family that does not match the instance family of these Standard RIs. How can the company take advantage of the Standard RIs that it no longer needs?
options: Contact the AWS Support team, and ask the team to sell the Standard RIs
Sell the Standard RIs on the Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance Marketplace
Sell the Standard RIs as a third-party seller on the AWS Marketplace
Convert the Standard RIs to Savings Plans
cards.a: B. Sell the Standard RIs on the Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance Marketplace
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (sell as third-party on AWS Marketplace), but unused Standard Reserved Instances are sold on the EC2 Reserved Instance Marketplace (B), which is a specific RI resale platform.

cards.q: A company is releasing a business-critical application. Before the release, the company needs strategic planning assistance from AWS. During the release, the company needs AWS infrastructure event management and real-time support. What should the company do to meet these requirements?
options: Sign up for AWS Enterprise Support
cards.a: C. Sign up for AWS Enterprise Support
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed D (Professional Services), but AWS Infrastructure Event Management (IEM) with real-time support during launches is an Enterprise Support feature (C). since both provide strategic planning.

cards.q: A company wants to improve employee productivity by providing a way for employees to search for questions and retrieve specific answers. The company wants to use a single intelligent search interface. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (Amazon Lex), but Lex builds conversational chatbots. Amazon Kendra (B) is the intelligent enterprise search service for finding specific answers.

cards.q: A company wants an Amazon S3 solution that provides access to object storage within single-digit milliseconds. Which solution will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: S3 Express One Zone is designed for single-digit millisecond access to frequently accessed data with the lowest latency of any S3 storage class; S3 Standard (B) provides low latency but not the guaranteed single-digit millisecond performance.

cards.q: A company runs an uninterruptible Amazon EC2 workload on AWS 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The company will require the same instance family and instance type to run the workload for the next 12 months. Which combination of purchasing options should the company choose to MOST optimize costs? (Choose two.)
cards.a: A. Standard Reserved Instance ; E. All Upfront payment
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (Convertible Reserved Instance only), but the question says "Choose two." For maximum savings on a fixed instance family, Standard RI (A) with All Upfront payment (E) provides the deepest discount.

cards.q: A company is planning to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company needs to understand the existing on-premises usage and configuration. The company does not want to replicate its workloads to AWS, yet. Which AWS service or tool will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (Cloud Migration Factory), but Application Discovery Service (A) is the standard AWS tool for understanding on-premises usage and configuration without replicating workloads.

cards.q: A company wants to allow its employees to work remotely from home. The company's employees use Windows or Linux desktops. The company's employees need access from anywhere and at anytime by using any supported devices. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (AppStream 2.0), but the question asks for full virtual desktops (Windows or Linux). Amazon WorkSpaces (A) provides complete managed desktops, while AppStream 2.0 streams individual applications. WorkSpaces better matches "desktops."

cards.q: A company wants to test a new application. Which AWS principle will help the company test the application?
options: Make long-term commitments in exchange for a cost discount.
Scale up and down when needed without any long-term commitments.
Have total control over the application infrastructure.
Manage all of the maintenance tasks associated with the cloud.
cards.a: B. Scale up and down when needed without any long-term commitments.
cards.explanation: The ability to scale up and down without long-term commitments enables rapid experimentation and testing of new applications, since resources can be provisioned quickly and released when testing is complete; long-term commitments (A) discourage experimentation.

cards.q: A company plans to launch an ecommerce website that contains many images for a product catalog. The company wants to keep the cost of running the website within a specific budget. Which AWS service or tool should the company use to monitor the ongoing costs of the website?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (EC2 Image Builder), but Image Builder creates AMIs. AWS Cost Explorer (A) monitors and visualizes ongoing costs against budgets.

cards.q: A company has an on-premises application. The application has processing times of less than 5 minutes and is invoked only a few times each day. The company wants to move the application to the AWS Cloud. Which AWS service will support this application MOST cost-effectively?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed A (Amazon ECS), but for a workload running less than 5 minutes, invoked only a few times daily, AWS Lambda (B) is the most cost-effective (pay per invocation, no idle compute).

cards.q: A company is learning about the perspectives of the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF). Which perspective of the AWS CAF addresses the strategy management capability?
cards.explanation: The Business perspective of the AWS CAF includes strategy management as a core capability, addressing how cloud initiatives align with and support business strategy; the Governance perspective (C) covers risk and financial management.

cards.q: A company wants to consolidate its call centers to improve the customer voice and chat experience with call center agents. Which AWS service or tool will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed B (AWS Support Center), but the Support Center is for opening technical support cases. Amazon Connect (D) is the cloud contact center service for improving customer voice and chat experiences.

cards.q: Which AWS service can migrate Amazon EC2 instances from one AWS Region to another?
cards.explanation: AWS Application Migration Service (formerly CloudEndure) migrates servers including EC2 instances across Regions by continuously replicating data and performing cutover; AWS DMS (B) migrates databases, not full EC2 instances.

cards.q: A company wants to deploy an application that stores data in a relational database. The company wants database tasks, such as automated backups and database snapshots, to be managed by AWS. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (Amazon EBS), but EBS is block storage volumes. Amazon RDS (B) is the managed relational database service with automated backups and snapshots.

cards.q: A company that operates on-premises servers decides to start a new line of business. The company determines that additional servers are required for the new workloads. Which advantage of cloud computing can help the company to provision additional infrastructure as quickly as possible?
options: Benefit from massive economies of scale
Trade fixed expense for variable expense
cards.explanation: the exam bank listed C (Trade fixed expense for variable expense), but the question asks about provisioning infrastructure "as quickly as possible." Increase speed and agility (B) directly describes rapid provisioning capability.
